sources.label: Official Ben Sherman UK Size Guide, Casualwear (body measurements, CMS rows)

audit: Old /pages/size-guide 404s; guide is /help/sizeguide (same chart on bensherman.co.uk and bensherman.com). Casualwear tab: Top Half chest and Bottom Half waist, body measurements, XS-4XL, single values (cm rows used). S 91/77 -> 95/79; M 97/83 -> 102/86; XL 109/95 -> 117/101; XXL 115/101 -> 2XL 126/109. XS, 3XL, 4XL added. UK/US/EU removed: letter sizes have no numeric equivalents printed (Formalwear tab lists chest-inch sizes 36-50 with Euro 46-60 separately).
